Visitor replaces input with labeled output

```elixir title="Elixir"
visitor = %{
      :handle_input => fn(args) ->

      end,
    }

result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<form><label>Username: <input type=\"text\" name=\"username\" value=\"\"></label><label>Password: <input type=\"password\" name=\"password\"></label></form>", %{visitor: visitor})
```
